3 mm on every side — extend background artwork into the bleed.

artwork.title: Die-line & folding
items: Place your artwork on the supplied keyline/die-line, on its own layer.
Keep the die-line as a non-printing spot colour.
Extend background art 3 mm over every fold and glue flap.
Avoid critical text or logos across fold / crease lines.

artwork.title: Before you send
items: Double-check spelling, contact details and the final size.
Flatten transparencies, or supply layered files if we've asked for them.
